Notes: Each directory next to this file is a tree with the repository layout that Scripts/Lint.py --self-test lints with --root and the listed Steps. It must report exactly the Expected findings (code, file, line): the seeded defect, and nothing else.

Modes runs the fixture once per checker mode of Scripts/Lint.py --mode: clang (clang-tidy naming, clang-query json access) and regex (the fallbacks). A clang run is skipped, and reported, when those tools are not installed. An Expected entry with its own Modes is expected only in those modes: what only a clang tool can find.

No premake script includes these trees, so they are never compiled by the build, and Lint.py on the repository never reads them: its C++ roots are the Source directories, and its Python and JSON steps exclude Tests/Data.

Fixtures.Name: UpwardInclude
Fixtures.Description: Core (layer 0) includes a Scene header (layer 3).

Fixtures.Name: ForbiddenLayer5Edge
Fixtures.Description: Session includes Testing: the reverse of the allowed layer-5 edge Session -> Testing.

Fixtures.Name: SnapshotHeaderNvrhi
Fixtures.Description: Renderer/RenderSnapshot.h includes NVRHI directly.

Fixtures.Name: SnapshotHeaderNvrhiTransitive
Fixtures.Description: Renderer/DebugDrawList.h reaches NVRHI through an Asset header, which also breaks the Asset rules itself.

Fixtures.Name: ThrowInFirstParty
Fixtures.Description: throw, and std::rethrow_exception, in an Engine source file.

Fixtures.Name: StdRand
Fixtures.Description: std::rand in Audio (not on the simulation path, so only the rand rule applies).

Fixtures.Name: StdSinInScene
Fixtures.Description: In Scene (simulation path): std::sin, a CRT call through a namespace alias of std, an Euler-angle glm::quat construction and glm::mix of quaternions; the std::sin in Renderer/Wave.cpp is allowed and must not be reported.

Fixtures.Name: MemberWithoutPrefix
Fixtures.Description: A private data member without m_, caught by clang-tidy and by the regex fallback.

Fixtures.Name: OverrideNaming
Fixtures.Description: Snake_case virtual functions declared in a first-party base class are reported; the overrides that keep those names (override and final) are the allowed controls, in clang-tidy and in the regex fallback.

Fixtures.Name: JsonAtOutsideCoreJson
Fixtures.Description: nlohmann json at() and get<>() in Scene instead of JsonReader: on json receivers, a receiver declared through a type alias, and (found by type, clang mode only) a value returned by a function held in auto and a call chain.

Fixtures.Name: FilesystemWithoutErrorCode
Fixtures.Description: std::filesystem::exists without an std::error_code; the is_directory call with one is fine.

Fixtures.Name: HeaderNotSelfContained
Fixtures.Description: A header that needs an include it does not have, and a header without #pragma once.

Fixtures.Name: PythonStyle
Fixtures.Description: An entry-point script without main(), type hints or an argument list, with a bare except.

Fixtures.Name: InvalidJson
Fixtures.Description: A duplicate key and a trailing comma.

Fixtures.Name: AbiMacroInSource
Fixtures.Description: #define and #undef of ABI-relevant configuration macros (Jolt, vulkan.hpp, glm) in a source file; IMGUI_DEFINE_MATH_OPERATORS is the allowed control.

Fixtures.Name: EditorCoreThirdParty
Fixtures.Description: EditorCore includes GLFW; the script type checker including LuauAnalysis is the allowed control.

Fixtures.Name: SpdlogOutsideLogHeader
Fixtures.Description: A public Core header other than Log.h includes spdlog; Log.h and Log.cpp are the allowed controls.

Fixtures.Name: ProductNameInScript
Fixtures.Description: The product name in a Python string and a premake string; comments naming it are the allowed controls.

Fixtures.Name: ContractStub
Fixtures.Description: ENGINE_CONTRACT_STUB left in an Engine source, a Tests support source and an inline function of Base.h, and redefined in a Runtime header; the definition in Base.h, a comment and a string literal that spell the marker are the allowed controls.

Fixtures.Name: UnexpectedTestSkip
Fixtures.Description: doctest::skip on ordinary test cases: plain, with the child-target suite only in a comment or in the name string, through a namespace alias in a TEST_CASE_FIXTURE, unqualified after using namespace doctest, and in a shared decorator outside any test macro. The child-process targets (decorator expressions over several lines, with a comment between the decorators, qualified and unqualified), a string and a comment that spell a skip, and a member named skip are the allowed controls.
